sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233462 (read 2026-11-06): 'The campground offers 47 campsites, 33 of which have electric hookups. Site 1 is an accessible site with 50-amp electric, water and sewer hookups. Sites 2-8, 34-43, 50 and 55 have 30-amp electric with water hookups. Sites 44-49, 51-54 and 56-60 are basic 30-amp electric ... Amenities include flush and vault toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station. A boat ramp, dock, marina and fish cleaning station are located on-site, as are an overlook, two nature trails, three playgrounds and a swim beach'; 'trees and shade are sparse within the campground'; rule maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days'; phone 785-549-3318.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233462/rates (read 2026-11-06): Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-29 (same for 2027, 2028): STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20, STANDARD ELECTRIC $23 (30 A, no water), $24 (30 A + water), $26 (site 1, 50 A full hookup).

recreation.gov campsite search for 233462 (read 2026-11-06): 48 overnight sites - 33 electric (32 at 30 A, site 01 at 50 A full hookup, accessible), 15 non-electric; back-ins 40-65 ft, site 01 a 100-ft paved pull-through; plus two day-use group shelters. Availability calendar: reservable 2027-05-01 to 2027-09-29; no sites offered Nov-Apr or in October.

Esri World Imagery with the per-site coordinates (38.5015,-95.7195 at 140 m and 38.5007,-95.7190 at 250 m), 2026-11-06: the campground fills a peninsula; the electric loop is in the middle ~120-150 m from water; non-electric sites 23-25 (gravel, NW) sit on the lake side of the outer loop road with an open sand/grass apron ~35-45 m to the shoreline, and 13-14 (gravel, NE) similarly ~25-40 m from the east cove; 26-32 are across the road from the west cove.

Google Maps 'Coeur d'Alene Campground Melvern Lake', 31408 Coeur dAlene Parkway, Lebo, KS: 4.6 stars, 63 reviews, phone +1 785-549-3318, place 38.50115,-95.71936 (read 2026-11-06). The USACE Kansas City District Melvern camping page answered 'Access Denied' to an automated read.

values.note: Peak season (May 1-Sep 29) rates: $20 non-electric, $23 30-A electric, $24 30-A electric with water, $26 for the accessible 50-A full-hookup site.

summary: Confirmed reservable, lakeview, 50 A + water (site 1 only for 50 A). Corrected fees 16-21 -> 20-26 (2026 peak rate table), sites 56 -> 48, max rig 100 -> 65 (100 is the accessible site). Added showers, flush/vault toilets, drinking water, dump, 14-in-30 max stay, recreation.gov link. Season left unknown (reservable May 1-Sep 29; off-season use not stated).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (upgrade): non-electric gravel sites 23, 24, 25 (NW tip) and 13, 14 (NE) sit on the lake side of the outer loop road with an open sand/grass apron ~25-45 m to the shoreline and no road between - an on-water call for those sites could be earned; the electric loop (most of the campground) is ~120-150 m back. Stored lakeview kept. Caveat: the exposed sand may be a low-pool apron.
Hookups (derived, left alone): electric 50 rests on site 01 only, the accessible site; every other electric site is 30 A. Consider 30 for general use; sewer correctly absent (1 site).

Count conflict: recreation.gov's description says '47 campsites', the catalog lists 48 overnight sites (33 electric + 15 non-electric); recorded 48. The stored 56 matches neither (numbering runs to 60 with gaps).
Season unknown: the rec.gov calendar only offers May 1-Sep 29; USACE's own Melvern page returned Access Denied, so off-season/FCFS use couldn't be confirmed. Not recorded.
militaryDiscount rule on rec.gov is the standard rule, not a discount claim - nothing recorded.
Pin fine (stored 38.5007,-95.7187 is the middle of the campground; Google place ~50 m away). Phone 785-549-3318 confirmed. Website OK. Google 4.6 / 63 reviews. No sand issue (paved and gravel pads).
